Links of every kind an agent writes:

- A markdown link: [the CommonMark spec](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/)
- A bare URL: https://github.com/example-org/example-app/blob/main/apps/web/src/components/ChatMarkdown.tsx
- A bare URL at the end of a sentence: see https://example.com.
- In parentheses (https://example.com/docs) and bold **https://example.com/bold**
- An autolink: <https://docs.rs/syntect/5.3.0/syntect/>
- Mail: <dev@example.com> and [write to us](mailto:dev@example.com)
- Refused schemes stay text: [call](tel:+15555550123), [app](intent://scan), [pair](broski://pair?v=2), [js](javascript:alert(1))
- A relative link: [the contract](docs/architecture/contract/README.md)
- A 2,000-character URL: https://example.com/search?q=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa&page=2

File paths, which should open in Files:

- `apps/ios/Broski/Sources/Features/Chat/Work/ToolDetailView.swift:63`
- `src/auth.ts:42:7`
- packages/link/render/src/lib.rs in plain prose
- `~/.broski/link/bridge.key` (never opened from the phone: outside the session)
- `C:\Users\dev\project\main.rs`
- Not paths: `v1.2.3`, `e.g.`, `1.5x`, `node.js`
